name: Kimberly-Clark Corporation
summary: Kimberly-Clark Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets personal care products in the United States. It operates in two segments, North America and International Personal Care. The North America segment offers disposable diapers, training and youth pants, swimpants, baby wipes, feminine and incontinence care products, reusable underwear, facial and bathroom tissue, pap
style_reason: weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert
verdict: Einstufung: Standardwert (gemischt) – weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert. Buffett-Score 49/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 16/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 67.52 USD (−38 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Mittel.
